extDescription.message: Ranked, stable Playwright locators for any element on the page — scored the same way Piwi's dashboard scores them.
extDescription.description: The manifest description: shown by the browser and used as the store listing's summary. At most 132 characters, the Chrome Web Store's limit.

pickElementCommand.message: Pick a locator for an element on the page
pickElementCommand.description: Label of the pick keyboard shortcut in the browser's shortcut settings.

common_languageTag.description: Not shown and not translated: the code of this catalog’s language (its _locales directory, with - for _). Sets the pages’ lang attribute.

common_recordingStartFailed.description: Error shown in the popup when starting a recording fails for an unknown reason.

common_screenshotNoTab.message: There is no tab to capture.
common_screenshotNoTab.description: Bug report: why a screenshot could not be taken.

common_screenshotTabHidden.message: The tab is not the one in front.
common_screenshotTabHidden.description: Bug report: why a screenshot could not be taken. The browser only captures the visible tab.

common_noProject.message: There is no project to refresh.
common_noProject.description: Error from the background worker when a panel asks to refresh data without naming a Piwi project.

common_notConnected.message: Piwi Picker is not connected to a Piwi instance.
common_notConnected.description: Error when data from a Piwi instance is needed and none is set up in Options.

common_healthOk.description: Popup, one line under the Active project row: the last request to the connected instance worked. $host$ is the instance's host name, $time$ how long ago, formatted by the browser (“5 minutes ago”, “yesterday”). One line.

common_healthUnreachable.description: Popup, one line under the Active project row: nothing has answered at the instance's address since $time$ (a clock time, or a date and a time). $settings$ is a link that opens the settings, common_healthCheck. One line.

common_healthUnauthorized.message: $host$ has refused the API key since $time$, $settings$.
common_healthUnauthorized.description: Popup, one line under the Active project row: the instance has refused Piwi Picker's API key since $time$ (revoked, or the instance moved). $settings$ is a link that opens the settings, common_healthReconnect. One line.

common_healthError.description: Popup, one line under the Active project row: the instance has answered with an error since $time$. $settings$ is a link that opens the settings, common_healthCheck. One line.

common_healthCheck.description: The link at the end of common_healthUnreachable and common_healthError, which opens the settings. Lower case: it ends a sentence.

common_healthReconnect.description: The link at the end of common_healthUnauthorized, which opens the settings. Lower case: it ends a sentence.

common_catalogRefreshFailed.message: The function catalog could not be refreshed.
common_catalogRefreshFailed.description: Error when the list of test functions could not be downloaded again from Piwi.

common_locatorIndexFailed.message: The tested elements could not be downloaded.
common_locatorIndexFailed.description: Error when the data behind “Tested elements” could not be downloaded from Piwi.

common_replayNeedsPage.message: A replay runs on a web page.
common_replayNeedsPage.description: Error when a bug report replay is started somewhere other than a web page.

common_replayNotSteps.message: This file is not a bug report’s steps: $error$
common_replayNotSteps.description: Error when the file chosen for a replay is not a steps file. $error$ is the first problem found in the file, in English, naming a field of the file.

common_replayNoSteps.description: Error when the bug report chosen for a replay has no steps.

common_replayNeedsAccess.message: Piwi Picker needs access to this site to follow the replay from page to page. Open Piwi Picker on this tab and choose Replay a bug report.
common_replayNeedsAccess.description: Error when a replay starts without the site’s permission. “Replay a bug report” is the popup button (popup_replayBug).

common_replayStartFailed.description: Error when a replay fails to start for an unknown reason.

common_sendForbidden.message: your account cannot send reports to this project.
common_sendForbidden.description: Background: the instance refused a bug report because the account may not send to that project.

common_sendTooLarge.message: the report is too large for the instance. Leave out a screenshot and try again.
common_sendTooLarge.description: Background: the instance refused a bug report as too large.

common_sendRefused.description: Background: the instance refused a bug report. $error$ is the instance’s own message, in English.

error.example: Not a bug report: steps: must be a list

common_bugReportsUnsupported.message: this Piwi instance does not take bug reports yet. Update it.
common_bugReportsUnsupported.description: Background: the connected instance is too old to take bug reports.

common_workerNoAnswer.message: Piwi Picker’s background worker did not answer: reload Piwi Picker.
common_workerNoAnswer.description: Error when the part of the extension that runs in the background does not answer a request.

common_enterInstanceUrl.message: Enter the address of your Piwi instance first.
common_enterInstanceUrl.description: Options: shown when testing or saving the connection with no address.

common_apiKeyRejected.message: The instance rejected the API key: check it.
common_apiKeyRejected.description: Options: the Piwi instance answered 401 or 403 to the connection test.

common_instanceStatus.message: The instance answered with an error ($status$).
common_instanceStatus.description: Options: the Piwi instance answered the connection test with an HTTP error. $status$ is the HTTP status code.

common_instanceUnreachable.message: Piwi Picker could not reach the instance: check the address, and that it is running.
common_instanceUnreachable.description: Options: the connection test got no answer.

common_instanceNotPiwi.message: The instance answered with something that is not Piwi: check the address, and that no sign-in page stands in front of it.
common_instanceNotPiwi.description: Options and the in-page tools: the instance answered, but not with Piwi’s data (a sign-in page, another site).

common_instanceRedirects.message: The instance answered with a redirect, which Piwi Picker does not follow: enter the address it leads to, such as https:// rather than http://.
common_instanceRedirects.description: Options: the connection test was redirected to another address, which the extension never follows.

common_desktopUnreachable.message: The desktop app does not answer. Is it running?
common_desktopUnreachable.description: The paired desktop app did not answer.

common_desktopRejected.message: The desktop app refused the token.
common_desktopRejected.description: The desktop app refused the token pasted in the options.

common_desktopUnsupported.message: This address is not a Piwi desktop app that can run bug reports.
common_desktopUnsupported.description: The address answers but is not a Piwi desktop app that takes run requests.

common_desktopNotProven.message: The program at this address did not prove it is the paired desktop app, so the token was not sent. Check that the app is running and up to date, then pair again.
common_desktopNotProven.description: The program at the paired address could not prove it holds the paired token: an app that moved to another port, an older app, or another program.

common_desktopStatus.description: The desktop app answered with an unexpected HTTP status. $status$ is the number.

common_projectsFailed.message: The list of projects could not be read ($status$).
common_projectsFailed.description: Options: listing the instance’s projects failed with an HTTP error. $status$ is the HTTP status code.

common_catalogFailed.message: The function catalog could not be downloaded ($status$).
common_catalogFailed.description: Downloading a project’s test functions failed with an HTTP error. $status$ is the HTTP status code.

common_projectKeyRejected.message: The instance rejected the API key for this project.
common_projectKeyRejected.description: Downloading a project’s tested elements was refused (401 or 403).

common_noLocatorIndex.message: This Piwi instance has no locator index for the project: update Piwi, or check the project.
common_noLocatorIndex.description: The Piwi instance does not know the “locator index” request (an older version) or the project. A locator index lists the locators a project’s tests use.

common_locatorIndexStatus.message: The locator index could not be downloaded ($status$).
common_locatorIndexStatus.description: Downloading a project’s locator index failed with an HTTP error. $status$ is the HTTP status code.

common_locatorIndexInvalid.message: The instance answered with something that is not a locator index.
common_locatorIndexInvalid.description: The Piwi instance’s answer could not be read as a locator index.

badge_recording.description: Toolbar badge while actions are recorded. At most 4 characters.

badge_bug.description: Toolbar badge while a bug report is recorded. At most 4 characters.

badge_replay.description: Toolbar badge while a bug report is replayed. At most 4 characters.

popup_settings.description: Popup: tooltip and accessible name of the gear button that opens the settings page.

popup_workerNotice.message: Piwi Picker was rebuilt since it was loaded, and part of it still runs the previous build, so some tools won’t answer. Reloading ends a recording in progress.
popup_workerNotice.description: Popup notice, seen by developers who build the extension themselves.

popup_reload.description: Popup: button of the notice above.

popup_activeProject.description: Popup: label of the menu choosing which Piwi project applies to this tab.

popup_autoMatched.description: Popup, active project menu: the project is chosen from the page address, and one matches.

popup_autoNoMatch.description: Popup, active project menu: the project is chosen from the page address, and none matches.

popup_noProjectHere.description: Popup: under the active project, when no URL pattern covers the current site.

popup_addSite.description: Popup: small button next to popup_noProjectHere that opens the settings to add the site. Short.

popup_addSiteTitle.message: Open the settings with this site’s pattern filled in

popup_testedElements.description: Popup tile: shows on the page which elements the project’s tests reach. Short.

popup_testedElementsHint.message: What your tests reach on this page, and what they miss
popup_testedElementsHint.description: Popup tile hint, under “Tested elements”. One line.

popup_testedElementsConnect.message: Connect to your Piwi instance to see what your tests reach
popup_testedElementsConnect.description: Popup tile hint, under “Tested elements”, when no Piwi instance is set up. One line.

devtools_playwrightView.description: Button in the toolbar of the DevTools Piwi panel: turns on labels showing each element as a Playwright test sees it. “Playwright” is a product name.

devtools_pick.description: DevTools, Piwi panel toolbar: button that starts Pick an element in the inspected page. One short word; the tooltip is devtools_pickTitle.

devtools_pickTitle.message: Pick an element on the page: its ranked, stable locators
devtools_pickTitle.description: DevTools, Piwi panel toolbar: tooltip of devtools_pick. One line.

devtools_lint.description: DevTools, Piwi panel toolbar: button that turns the lint overlay on in the inspected page. One short word, as popup_lint; the tooltip is devtools_lintTitle.

devtools_lintTitle.message: Mark the elements of the page that are hard to test
devtools_lintTitle.description: DevTools, Piwi panel toolbar: tooltip of devtools_lint. One line.

devtools_testedElements.description: DevTools, Piwi panel toolbar: button that opens Tested elements in the inspected page, as popup_testedElements. Its tooltip is devtools_testedElementsTitle, or why it cannot run.

devtools_testedElementsTitle.message: What your tests reach on this page, and what they miss
devtools_testedElementsTitle.description: DevTools, Piwi panel toolbar: tooltip of devtools_testedElements when it can run. One line.

devtools_saveLogin.description: Button in the toolbar of the DevTools Piwi panel: opens the page that saves the site's login as a Playwright storageState file.

devtools_viewportLabel.message: Open this page at a viewport
devtools_viewportLabel.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport bar: label of the select that opens the inspected page at a chosen viewport size.

devtools_viewportProject.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport select: one of the project's Playwright projects. $project$ is its name, like Mobile Safari; $size$ its viewport, like 390×844.

devtools_viewportCustom.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport select: the option that shows width and height fields.

devtools_viewportWidth.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport bar: accessible name of the width field, in CSS pixels.

devtools_viewportHeight.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport bar: accessible name of the height field, in CSS pixels.

devtools_viewportOnly.message: Viewport only: no touch, pixel ratio or user agent.
devtools_viewportOnly.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport bar: what the new window or the tab does not emulate. Short.

devtools_viewportHere.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport bar: button that sets the viewport of the inspected tab itself, rather than opening a window. Short.

devtools_viewportHereOn.message: This tab shows its page at $size$.
devtools_viewportHereOn.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport bar: the tab shows its page at a viewport set from the bar. $size$ is a width × height such as 390×844.

devtools_viewportReset.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport bar: link that puts the tab back to its window's size.

devtools_viewportHereUnavailable.message: This browser gives extensions no debugging protocol to set the tab’s own viewport: open a window instead.
devtools_viewportHereUnavailable.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport bar: the tab's own viewport cannot be set in a browser without the debugging protocol (Firefox).

devtools_viewportHereRefused.message: The browser refused the debugging session: $error$
devtools_viewportHereRefused.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport bar: the browser refused the debugging session the tab's own viewport needs. $error$ is the browser's words.

error.example: Another debugger is already attached to the tab.

devtools_viewportInvalid.message: Open a web page, at a width and height between $min$ and $max$ pixels.
devtools_viewportInvalid.description: Piwi panel in DevTools, viewport bar: the page or the size cannot be opened. $min$ and $max$ are sizes in pixels.

popup_reportBug.description: Popup tile: records the steps of a bug. Short.

popup_reportBugHint.message: Steps and what's wrong → a failing test
popup_reportBugHint.description: Popup tile hint, under “Report a bug”, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 42 characters.

popup_replayBug.description: Popup tile: plays a bug report’s steps on the current site. Short.

popup_replayBugHint.message: Play its steps here, with a cursor
popup_replayBugHint.description: Popup tile hint, under “Replay a bug report”, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 40 characters.

popup_record.description: Popup tile: records clicks and typing into a test. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_recordHint.description: Popup tile hint, under “Record actions”. At most about 22 characters.

popup_pick.description: Popup tile: click an element of the page to get its locators. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_pickHint.description: Popup tile hint. A locator is Playwright’s way to find an element (see the glossary). At most about 22 characters.

popup_multiPick.description: Popup tile: pick a few items of a list to get a locator for all of them. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_multiPickHint.description: Popup tile hint, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 22 characters.

popup_lint.description: Popup tile: outlines the elements of the page that are hard to find from a test. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_lintHint.description: Popup tile hint, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 22 characters.

popup_assertions.description: Popup tile: suggests checks for an element. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_assertionsHint.description: Popup tile hint. expect(…) is code: keep it as is. At most about 22 characters.

popup_agentContext.description: Popup tile: describes an element for an AI coding agent. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_agentContextHint.description: Popup tile hint, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 22 characters.

popup_testFunctions.description: Popup tile: checks which of the project’s test functions work on this page. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_testFunctionsHint.description: Popup tile hint, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 22 characters.

popup_moreTools.description: Popup: small heading above the compact tiles of the other tools (multi-pick, assertions, lint overlay, agent context, test functions). Short.

popup_devtoolsNote.message: The locator console, the session, network mocks, viewports, Playwright view and Save login are in DevTools, in the Piwi panel.
popup_devtoolsNote.description: Popup, above the footer: where the developer tools are, in the browser's DevTools. “Piwi” names the panel as it appears in DevTools. Two lines at most.

popup_running.description: Popup: marks the tile of the tool running on the page, after “·”.

popup_pickShortcut.message: $shortcut$ picks an element without the popup
popup_pickShortcut.description: Popup footer: the browser-wide keyboard shortcut, shown as a key cap. $shortcut$ is the shortcut the browser assigned.

popup_noPickShortcut.message: No pick shortcut assigned: set one
popup_noPickShortcut.description: Popup footer link to the browser’s shortcut settings, when no key is assigned.

popup_docs.description: Popup footer link to the documentation, which is in English.

popup_noTab.message: There is no active tab to work on.

popup_cannotRun.message: Piwi Picker can’t run on this page: browsers keep their own pages and extension stores out of reach.
popup_cannotRun.description: Popup error, on a browser page such as the settings or an extension store.

popup_tabShowsError.message: This tab shows an error page instead of the site. Is the site running? Reload the tab once it is, then try again.
popup_tabShowsError.description: Popup error when the tab shows the browser's error page (for example a local dev server that is not running), so no tool can open in it.

popup_blockedByPolicy.message: Your organization’s browser settings keep extensions off this site.
popup_blockedByPolicy.description: Popup error when an enterprise policy forbids extensions on the tab's site.

popup_buildIncomplete.message: This build of Piwi Picker has no $file$. Rebuild the extension, then reload it in the browser’s extensions page.
popup_buildIncomplete.description: Popup error when a tool's script is missing from the extension's files, which only happens with a development build that is out of date. $file$ is the script's file name.

popup_cannotRunBecause.message: Piwi Picker can’t run on this page. The browser says: $reason$
popup_cannotRunBecause.description: Popup error for any other reason the browser gives for refusing to open a tool in the tab. $reason$ is the browser's own message, in English.

reason.example: Cannot access contents of the page.

popup_stopRecording.description: Popup tile during a recording. $count$ is the number of steps recorded.

popup_finishBugReport.description: Popup tile during a bug report recording. $count$ is the number of steps recorded.

popup_stepsSoFar.description: Popup tile hint during a recording.

popup_reviewRecording.description: Popup tile once a recording is stopped. $count$ is the number of steps recorded.

popup_reviewBugReport.description: Popup tile once a bug report recording is stopped.

popup_notExported.description: Popup tile hint once a recording is stopped.

popup_takeScreenshot.description: Popup tile during a bug report recording.

popup_screenshotHint_one.message: Adds this tab, as it is now, to the bug report ($count$ event so far)
popup_screenshotHint_one.description: Popup tile hint under “Take a screenshot”, for one event. $count$ is the number of events recorded.

popup_screenshotHint_other.message: Adds this tab, as it is now, to the bug report ($count$ events so far)
popup_screenshotHint_other.description: Popup tile hint under “Take a screenshot”, for several events. $count$ is the number of events recorded.

popup_reviewBugReportHint.message: Copy the failing test or the report, or download it
popup_reviewBugReportHint.description: Popup tile hint once a bug report recording is stopped.

popup_finishFirst.message: Finish or discard the current recording first
popup_finishFirst.description: Popup tile hint under “Report a bug” while another recording exists.

popup_finishBeforeBug.message: Finish or discard the current recording before reporting a bug.
popup_finishBeforeBug.description: Popup error on “Report a bug” while another recording exists.

popup_permissionNeeded.message: Piwi Picker needs access to this site to record from page to page.
popup_permissionNeeded.description: Popup error when the site permission a recording needs was refused.

popup_cannotRecord.message: Piwi Picker can’t record on this page.
popup_cannotRecord.description: Popup error on a page that is not a web site.

popup_cannotReplay.message: Piwi Picker can’t replay a report on this page.
popup_cannotReplay.description: Popup error on a page that is not a web site.

popup_replayElsewhere.message: A replay is running in another tab. Stop it there, or in the Piwi panel in DevTools, before replaying here.
popup_replayElsewhere.description: Popup status when Replay a bug report is clicked while a replay runs or is paused in another tab, which alone plays it.

popup_notRecordedTab.message: This tab is not the one being recorded.
popup_notRecordedTab.description: Popup error on “Take a screenshot” in another tab.

popup_stateUnreadable.message: Piwi Picker couldn’t tell whether a recording is running: open it again.
popup_stateUnreadable.description: Popup error when the recording state could not be read. “it” is the popup.

options_title.description: Settings page: its title and heading.

options_language.description: Settings page: label of the language menu.

options_languageBrowser.description: Settings page, language menu: follow the browser’s language. $language$ is the name of the language shown, in that language.

options_languageHint.message: The language of Piwi Picker’s own texts. Page texts, locators and the tests it writes stay as they are.
options_languageHint.description: Settings page: hint under the language menu.

options_draftNote.message: This translation is a draft: no native reader has reviewed it yet. $link$
options_draftNote.description: Settings, under the Language setting, shown only while the interface is in a draft language, in that language. $link$ is a link whose text is options_draftNoteLink.

options_draftNoteLink.description: Settings: the text of the link, after options_draftNote, that opens GitHub’s form for translation fixes.

options_languageSaved.description: Settings page: confirmation after choosing a language.

options_languageFailed.message: The language could not be changed: $error$
options_languageFailed.description: Settings page: error after choosing a language. $error$ is the reason, often in English.

options_connectHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the connection settings.

options_stateConnected.description: Settings page: badge beside the Connect to Piwi heading once connected. One word.

options_stateNotConnected.description: Settings page: badge beside the Connect to Piwi heading before connecting. Short.

options_desktopOffer.message: The desktop app you paired runs Piwi on this computer: use it as your instance, with its address and token.
options_desktopOffer.description: Settings page, Connect to Piwi card: shown when the desktop app is paired and no instance is connected, beside the options_useDesktop button.

options_useDesktop.message: Use the desktop app as your instance
options_useDesktop.description: Settings page, Connect to Piwi card: the button that connects to the paired desktop app's own Piwi instance in one click.

options_desktopPairHint.message: To run bug reports with Playwright on this computer, $link$.
options_desktopPairHint.description: Settings page, Connect to Piwi card: shown when an instance is connected and the desktop app is not paired. $link$ is options_desktopPairHintLink, a link to the Desktop app card.

options_desktopPairHintLink.description: The link in options_desktopPairHint, which leads to the Desktop app card's Pair button. Lower case: it ends a sentence.

options_healthOk.description: Settings page, a pill beside the instance's address: the last request to the instance worked. $time$ is how long ago, formatted by the browser (“5 minutes ago”). A few words.

options_healthUnreachable.description: Settings page, a pill beside the instance's address: nothing has answered there since $time$ (a clock time, or a date and a time). A few words.

options_healthUnauthorized.description: Settings page, a pill beside the instance's address: the instance has refused the API key since $time$. A few words.

options_healthError.description: Settings page, a pill beside the instance's address: the instance has answered with errors since $time$. A few words.

options_statePaired.description: Settings page: badge beside the Desktop app and Send to editor headings once paired. One word.

options_stateNotPaired.description: Settings page: badge beside the Desktop app and Send to editor headings before pairing. Short.

options_lead.message: Optional. Connected to your Piwi instance, the recorder uses your projects’ own page objects and helper functions, and ranks them live as you record. Picking locators and recording a plain test always work without it.
options_lead.description: Settings page: introduction of the connection settings.

options_instanceUrl.description: Settings page: label of the address field.

options_instanceUrlPlaceholder.description: Settings page: example in the empty address field.

options_apiKey.description: Settings page: label of the API key field.

options_apiKeyHint.message: Create one in the Piwi dashboard, in your account’s API key settings.
options_apiKeyHint.description: Settings page: hint under the API key field.

options_apiKeySave.description: Settings page, under “Use an API key instead”: saves the address and the key typed, after checking that the instance accepts them. Short.

options_mappingsHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the table saying which Piwi project applies on which site.

options_mappingsHint.message: Which project applies on which site. Patterns kept in this browser are read first, then your instance’s, and the first that matches wins. $star$ matches within one part of the path, $globstar$ across parts. The branch, optional, is the one deployed at those addresses (a staging site on $example$, say): Tested elements then shows what that branch’s tests reach.
options_mappingsHint.description: Settings page: hint of the project mappings. The placeholders are shown as code. $example$ is a branch name; $globstar$ is the wildcard across parts of a path; $star$ is the wildcard for one part of a path.

options_sitesConnectFirst.message: Sites map to your instance’s projects: connect first.
options_sitesConnectFirst.description: Settings page, Project mappings card: shown instead of the pattern lists before Piwi Picker is connected to an instance.

options_addMapping.description: Settings page: button adding a line to the project mappings.

options_noMappings.message: No lines yet: add one below.
options_noMappings.description: Settings page: the project mappings are empty.

options_pattern.description: Settings page: accessible name of a line’s address pattern field.

options_patternPlaceholder.description: Settings page: example in an empty address pattern field. Keep /** at the end.

options_project.description: Settings page: accessible name of a line’s project menu.

options_projectTestFirst.description: Settings page: project menu of a line before the instance's projects could be read (Refresh reads them again).

options_projectChoose.description: Settings page: project menu with nothing chosen.

options_branch.description: Settings page: accessible name of a line’s branch field.

options_branchPlaceholder.description: Settings page: shown in an empty branch field.

options_branchTitle.message: The branch deployed at these addresses: Tested elements shows what its tests reach
options_branchTitle.description: Settings page: tooltip of a line’s branch field.

options_pathPrefix.description: Settings page: accessible name of a line’s path prefix field.

options_pathPrefixPlaceholder.description: Settings page: shown in an empty path prefix field. Short.

options_pathPrefixTitle.message: Your site serves the pages under this path, the tests did not, e.g. /app
options_pathPrefixTitle.description: Settings page: tooltip of a line’s path prefix field. Keep /app as the example.

options_pathPrefixInvalid.message: $prefix$ is not a path prefix: write a plain path such as /app, with no query, hash or wildcard, and at most 4 parts.
options_pathPrefixInvalid.description: Settings page: status and tooltip when a path prefix field holds a value that is refused. $prefix$ is what was typed.

options_testPathPrefix.description: Settings page: accessible name of a line’s tests’ path prefix field: the path the tests ran the pages under and the site does not.

options_testPathPrefixPlaceholder.description: Settings page: shown in an empty tests’ path prefix field. Short.

options_testPathPrefixTitle.message: The tests ran the pages under this path, your site does not, e.g. /app
options_testPathPrefixTitle.description: Settings page: tooltip of a line’s tests’ path prefix field. Keep /app as the example.

options_removeMapping.description: Settings page: accessible name of the × button of a line.

options_save.description: Settings page: button saving the connection.

options_privacy.message: Only used from this page: the API key never reaches a web page’s scripts. Recorded steps go nowhere unless you copy them, download them or send them to your paired editor or desktop app. Connecting downloads your projects’ URL patterns, each mapped project’s function catalog and the elements its tests reach; adding a site sends only its pattern.
options_privacy.description: Settings page: privacy note at the bottom.

options_testing.description: Settings page: status while testing the connection.

options_desktopHeading.description: Options: heading of the section pairing the desktop app.

options_desktopHint.message: Optional. Paired with the Piwi Dashboard desktop app, Replay can ask it to run a bug report with Playwright in your project.
options_desktopHint.description: Options: what pairing the desktop app is for and where the address and token come from.

options_desktopUrl.description: Options: label of the desktop app's address field.

options_desktopUrlHint.message: Shown on the app’s Setup page, under Connect Piwi Picker. Pair asks the app’s window to allow Piwi Picker.
options_desktopUrlHint.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: under the address field. “Setup” and “Connect Piwi Picker” name the desktop app’s page and card; “Pair” is options_desktopPair.

options_desktopPair.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: button asking the desktop app to pair; its window then shows an Allow button. One word.

options_desktopManual.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: folded section where the token is pasted by hand. Short.

options_desktopToken.description: Options: label of the desktop app's token field.

options_desktopManualHint.message: The token is on the app’s Setup page, under Connect Piwi Picker, beside its address.
options_desktopManualHint.description: Settings page, Desktop app card, Pair by hand: where the token comes from.

options_desktopSave.description: Options: button that checks the desktop app's address and token, then keeps them.

options_desktopForget.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: forgets the pairing with the desktop app. One word.

options_desktopPairedAt.message: Paired with the desktop app at $url$.
options_desktopPairedAt.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: the pairing in place. $url$ is the app’s address, like http://127.0.0.1:3000.

options_desktopPairStarting.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: while the pairing request is sent.

options_desktopPairCode.message: Allow Piwi Picker in the desktop app’s window, after checking it shows $code$.
options_desktopPairCode.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: while the app waits for the Allow click. $code$ is the code both sides show, like BCDF-GHJK.

options_desktopPairNoWindow.message: Open the desktop app’s window: the request waits for you there.
options_desktopPairNoWindow.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: the app runs but no window of it is open to show the request.

options_desktopPairDenied.message: Pairing was denied in the desktop app.
options_desktopPairDenied.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: Deny was clicked in the app.

options_desktopPairExpired.message: The request expired before it was allowed. Click Pair to ask again.
options_desktopPairExpired.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: nobody answered in the app in time.

options_desktopPairCancelled.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: Cancel was clicked while waiting.

options_desktopPairUnreachable.message: Nothing answers at $url$. Is the desktop app running? Its Setup page shows its address.
options_desktopPairUnreachable.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: the address did not answer. $url$ is the address typed.

options_desktopPairUnsupported.message: What answers at $url$ cannot pair in one step: check the address on the desktop app’s Setup page, update the app, or pair by hand.
options_desktopPairUnsupported.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: the address answered, but not as a desktop app that pairs (another server, or an older app). $url$ is the address typed.

options_desktopPairTooMany.message: Three pairings already wait in the desktop app’s window: answer them first.
options_desktopPairTooMany.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: the app refuses a fourth waiting request.

options_desktopForgotten.message: The desktop app is no longer paired.
options_desktopForgotten.description: Options: the desktop app's address and token were removed.

options_desktopNotLoopback.message: Enter the desktop app’s own address, such as http://127.0.0.1:3000.
options_desktopNotLoopback.description: Options: the address is not the desktop app's own loopback address, or the token is empty.

options_desktopNeedsToken.message: Paste the token from the app’s Setup page first.
options_desktopNeedsToken.description: Settings page, Desktop app card: Save and test was clicked with no token.

options_desktopNeedsAccess.message: Allow access to the desktop app’s address to pair it.
options_desktopNeedsAccess.description: Options: the browser's permission for the desktop app's address was not granted.

options_accessDenied.message: Access to that instance was refused: allow it to let Piwi Picker read your catalog.
options_accessDenied.description: Settings page: the browser’s permission for the instance address was refused.

options_connected_one.description: Settings page: connection test succeeded, one project. $count$ is the number of projects.

options_connected_other.description: Settings page: connection test succeeded, several projects. $count$ is the number of projects.

options_saved_one.description: Settings page: after Save, one project mapping line saved. Other sentences may follow. $count$ is the number of lines.

options_saved_other.description: Settings page: after Save, several project mapping lines saved. $count$ is the number of lines.

options_skipped_one.description: Settings page: after Save, one line lacked a pattern or a project. $count$ is the number of lines.

options_skipped_other.description: Settings page: after Save, several lines lacked a pattern or a project. $count$ is the number of lines.

options_plainHttp.message: This instance uses plain HTTP, so the API key travels unencrypted.
options_plainHttp.description: Settings page: after Save, a warning.

options_refreshDenied.message: Access to the instance was refused, so the catalog will not refresh on its own.
options_refreshDenied.description: Settings page: after Save, the instance permission was refused.

options_cached.description: Settings page: after Save, the test functions downloaded. $functions$ is a count of functions (options_functionCount); $projects$ is a count of projects (options_projectCount).

options_functionCount_one.description: Settings page: part of options_cached. $count$ is the number of functions.

options_functionCount_other.description: Settings page: part of options_cached. $count$ is the number of functions.

options_projectCount_one.description: Settings page: part of options_cached. $count$ is the number of projects.

options_projectCount_other.description: Settings page: part of options_cached. $count$ is the number of projects.

options_catalogsFailed_one.description: Settings page: after Save, downloads that failed. $count$ is the number of catalogs.

options_catalogsFailed_other.description: Settings page: after Save, downloads that failed. $count$ is the number of catalogs.

options_disconnectedKept_one.message: Disconnected. This browser’s $count$ line comes back when you connect to this instance again.
options_disconnectedKept_one.description: Settings page: after Disconnect, when one line under This browser only is kept for the next connection to the same instance. $count$ is the number of lines.

options_disconnectedKept_other.message: Disconnected. This browser’s $count$ lines come back when you connect to this instance again.
options_disconnectedKept_other.description: Settings page: after Disconnect, when several lines under This browser only are kept for the next connection to the same instance. $count$ is the number of lines.

options_connect.description: Settings page: button next to the instance address that starts connecting (opens the instance to allow Piwi Picker). Short.

options_connectHint.message: Opens your instance in a new tab, where you allow Piwi Picker; it then receives its own API key.
options_connectHint.description: Settings page: hint under the instance address, explaining what Connect does.

options_connectStarting.description: Settings page: status while the connection request is being started.

options_connectCode.message: Allow Piwi Picker in the tab that opened, after checking it shows $code$.
options_connectCode.description: Settings page: shown while waiting for the user to allow Piwi Picker on the instance. $code$ is the code the instance page also shows (like BCDF-GHJK), shown as code.

options_connectCancel.description: Settings page: button that stops waiting for the user to allow the connection. Short.

options_connectedAs.description: Settings page: the connection works. $name$ is the name of the account on the Piwi instance.

options_connectedNoAuth.message: Connected. Authentication is off on this instance, so no API key is needed.
options_connectedNoAuth.description: Settings page: the connection works, with an instance that has sign-in turned off.

options_connectDenied.message: Piwi Picker was denied on your instance.
options_connectDenied.description: Settings page: the user clicked Deny on the instance.

options_connectExpired.message: The code expired before it was allowed. Click Connect to start again.
options_connectExpired.description: Settings page: nobody allowed the connection within ten minutes. Names the Connect button (options_connect).

options_connectCancelled.description: Settings page: the user cancelled while waiting for the connection.

options_connectUnsupported.message: This instance can’t connect in one step: update it, or use an API key instead.
options_connectUnsupported.description: Settings page: the instance is too old for the one-step connection.

options_connectTooMany.message: Too many connection attempts from this address. Wait a few minutes and try again.
options_connectTooMany.description: Settings page: the instance refused because of too many connection attempts.

options_useApiKey.description: Settings page: folded section to paste an API key by hand instead of connecting.

options_localHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the URL patterns kept in this browser only.

options_serverHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the URL patterns read from the Piwi instance.

options_serverHint.message: Set in each project’s settings, under Browser extension URLs, and read each time this page opens.
options_serverHint.description: Settings page: hint under options_serverHeading. “Browser extension URLs” is the name of the section in the dashboard, which is in English: keep it in English.

options_serverRefresh.description: Settings page: button that reads the URL patterns from the instance again. Short.

options_serverReading.message: Reading the patterns from your instance…
options_serverReading.description: Settings page: status while the URL patterns are read from the instance.

options_serverEmpty.message: Your instance has no URL pattern for your projects yet.
options_serverEmpty.description: Settings page: the instance has no URL pattern for any project the user can see.

options_serverNotRead.description: Settings page: in place of the instance’s URL patterns, before the first connection.

options_serverSyncFailed.message: Couldn’t read the patterns from your instance ($error$). The ones read last time still apply.
options_serverSyncFailed.description: Settings page: the URL patterns could not be read from the instance. $error$ is the reason, a whole sentence.

error.example: The instance answered with an error (500).

options_serverUnsupported.message: This instance has no URL patterns to share: update it to read them.
options_serverUnsupported.description: Settings page: the instance is too old to share URL patterns.

options_serverPatterns_one.description: Settings page: after connecting or refreshing, one URL pattern read from the instance. $count$ is the number.

options_serverPatterns_other.description: Settings page: after connecting or refreshing, several URL patterns read from the instance. $count$ is the number.

options_sourceServer.description: Settings page: small tag on a URL pattern that comes from the instance. The product name.

options_serverPathPrefix.description: Settings page: part of an instance pattern’s line, after the project, environment and branch, joined by ·. $prefix$ is like /app.

options_serverTestPathPrefix.description: Settings page: part of an instance pattern’s line, after the path prefix, joined by ·. $prefix$ is like /app.

options_addHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the form that adds a URL pattern for a site.

options_addHint.message: Adds the pattern to a project on your instance, for everyone who connects to it. It takes a role that can edit the project.

options_environment.description: Settings page: accessible name of the environment field (staging, production…).

options_environmentPlaceholder.description: Settings page: placeholder of the environment field.

options_addToServer.description: Settings page: button that adds the pattern to the chosen project on the instance. Short.

options_addLocally.description: Settings page: button that adds the pattern to this browser’s own lines instead. Short.

options_addNoEditable.message: Your role can’t edit any project on this instance: keep the pattern in this browser, or ask an administrator to add it.
options_addNoEditable.description: Settings page: under the add form, when the user may not add patterns to any project.

options_addNeedsPattern.description: Settings page: the add form was used with no pattern.

options_addNeedsProject.description: Settings page: Add to Piwi was clicked with no project chosen.

options_added.description: Settings page: a pattern was added on the instance. $pattern$ is the pattern; $project$ is the project’s name.

options_addedLocally.message: Added to this browser’s lines. Click Save to keep it.
options_addedLocally.description: Settings page: a pattern was added to this browser’s lines, which are kept on Save (options_save).

options_addDuplicate.message: That project already has this pattern.
options_addDuplicate.description: Settings page: the instance already has this pattern for the project.

options_addForbidden.message: Your role can’t edit this project.
options_addForbidden.description: Settings page: the user’s role may not add patterns to the project.

options_addInvalid.message: Start the pattern with http://, https:// or a wildcard.
options_addInvalid.description: Settings page: the instance refused the pattern. http://, https:// stay as they are.

options_editorHeading.description: Heading of the settings section that pairs Piwi Picker with an editor on this computer.

options_editorHint.message: In VS Code or a JetBrains IDE with the Piwi extension, run “Piwi: Pair with Piwi Picker” and paste the address it copies here. Picked locators and recorded steps can then be sent to that editor, on this computer only, and are inserted at its cursor.
options_editorHint.description: Explains how to pair with an editor and what is sent. Piwi: Pair with Piwi Picker is the editor command’s name, in English.

options_editorAddress.description: Label of the field that takes the address an editor copies when pairing.

options_editorPair.description: Button that saves the pairing address.

options_editorUnpair.description: Button that forgets the paired editor.

options_siteAccessHeading.message: Sites Piwi Picker may run on
options_siteAccessHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the card listing the sites Piwi Picker holds a host permission for.

options_siteAccessHint.message: A site you allow is one Piwi Picker can run on without a click on its icon, so a recording or a replay follows you across its pages. It asks for each site the first time a tool needs it.
options_siteAccessHint.description: Settings page, under options_siteAccessHeading: what allowing a site grants, and when Piwi Picker asks for one.

options_siteAccessEmpty.message: No site yet: Piwi Picker asks for one the first time you record or replay there.
options_siteAccessEmpty.description: Settings page, the sites card: shown when no site is allowed.

options_siteRevoke.description: Settings page, the sites card: the button that takes a site's permission back. One word if possible.

options_siteRevokeLabel.description: Settings page, the sites card: what a screen reader reads for the Revoke button of one site. $site$ is its pattern, such as https://shop.example/*.

options_siteUseInstance.message: Used by your Piwi instance: Disconnect removes this access.
options_siteUseInstance.description: Settings page, the sites card: beside the connected Piwi instance's address, whose Revoke is disabled. “Disconnect” is the Connect to Piwi card's button (options_disconnect).

options_siteUseDesktop.message: Used by the desktop app: Unpair removes this access.
options_siteUseDesktop.description: Settings page, the sites card: beside the paired desktop app's address, whose Revoke is disabled. “Unpair” is the Desktop app card's button (options_desktopForget).

options_siteUseEditor.message: Used by your editor: Unpair removes this access.
options_siteUseEditor.description: Settings page, the sites card: beside the paired editor's address, whose Revoke is disabled. “Unpair” is the Send to editor card's button (options_editorUnpair).

options_siteBusyRecording.message: A recording is running there: stop it first.
options_siteBusyRecording.description: Settings page, the sites card: beside a site a recording runs on, whose Revoke is disabled until it ends.

options_siteBusyReplay.message: A replay is running there: stop it first.
options_siteBusyReplay.description: Settings page, the sites card: beside a site a replay runs on, whose Revoke is disabled until it ends.

options_siteRevoked.message: Piwi Picker no longer runs on $site$ unless you click its icon there.
options_siteRevoked.description: Settings page, the sites card's status line after Revoke. $site$ is the site's pattern.

options_siteRevokeFailed.message: The browser kept the access to $site$: remove it in the browser’s extension settings.
options_siteRevokeFailed.description: Settings page, the sites card's status line when the browser refused to take a site's permission back. $site$ is the site's pattern.

options_editorPaired.description: Status once paired. $url$ is the editor’s local address.

options_editorInvalid.message: This is not a pairing address. It looks like http://127.0.0.1:47211/piwi/send#… and comes from the editor’s “Pair with Piwi Picker” command.
options_editorInvalid.description: Error when the pasted text is not a pairing address.

options_editorPermission.message: Piwi Picker needs permission to reach the editor on this computer.
options_editorPermission.description: Error when the user declines the permission to reach the editor’s local address.

common_close.description: Button or aria-label that closes a panel or dialog.

common_copy.description: Button that copies a text to the clipboard.

common_copied.description: A copy button’s label for a second after a successful copy.

common_copyFailed.description: A copy button’s label for a second when the browser refused to write to the clipboard. Short: it replaces the button’s own label.

common_sentToEditor.description: A Send to editor button’s label for a second after the editor accepted what was sent.

common_sendToEditorFailed.description: A Send to editor button’s label when the editor did not accept what was sent; the reason is in the button’s tooltip.

common_cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.

common_save.description: Button that saves what a dialog asks for.

common_stop.description: Button that stops a recording or a replay.

common_discard.description: Button that throws away a recording in progress.

common_refresh.description: Button that downloads fresh data from the Piwi instance.

common_refreshing.description: The Refresh button while it works.

common_escToClose.description: Hint in a panel’s corner: the Escape key closes it.

common_clickToCopy.description: Tooltip of a text that copies itself when clicked.

console_expression.description: Locator console: aria-label of the text field where a Playwright locator is typed.

console_unique.description: Locator console verdict when the locator finds exactly one element, after a ✓. “Strict mode” is Playwright’s rule that an action fails when a locator finds several elements. Short: the bar is one line.

console_none.description: Locator console verdict when the locator finds nothing on the page.

console_many_one.description: Locator console verdict when the locator finds several elements, after a ⚠: a Playwright action on it would fail.

console_many_other.description: Locator console verdict when the locator finds several elements, after a ⚠: a Playwright action on it would fail.

console_invalidCss.message: $selector$ is not a CSS selector this page accepts
console_invalidCss.description: Locator console error: the browser refused the CSS selector inside locator(…). $selector$ is the selector as typed.

console_unreadable.message: The console can’t read this locator: $error$
console_unreadable.description: Locator console error. $error$ is the parser’s message, in English, naming what it could not read.

common_copyModeBare.description: Copy button under a locator: copies the locator alone, as `page.getByRole(…)`. One word.

common_copyModeAction.description: Copy button under a locator: copies it as an action line, `await page.….click();`, or `fill`, `check` or `selectOption` as the element calls for. One word.

common_copyModeExpect.description: Copy button under a locator: copies it as an assertion line, `await expect(page.…).toHaveText(…);`, the element's top assertion, `toBeVisible()` when nothing better applies. One word.

common_copyModeWithMethod.description: Copy button under a locator, once the element tells what the line calls: $mode$ is common_copyModeAction or common_copyModeExpect, $method$ the Playwright method it writes, e.g. `fill` or `toHaveText` (code, not translated). Reads “Action (fill)”.

multipick_picked_one.description: Multi-pick: the bar shown between picks, before its buttons. $count$ is how many items of the list were picked (2 or 3).

multipick_picked_other.description: Multi-pick: the bar shown between picks, before its buttons. $count$ is how many items of the list were picked (2 or 3).

multipick_derive.description: Multi-pick: main button of the bar between picks. Builds the locators shared by the picked items of a list. Short.

multipick_pickMore.description: Multi-pick: button of the bar between picks that picks another item of the list. $max$ is the most items it takes.

multipick_cancel.description: Multi-pick: aria-label of the × button of the bar between picks.

multipick_noPattern.message: No shared pattern found. Pick items of the same kind, such as rows of one table or cards of one list.
multipick_noPattern.description: Multi-pick: message shown for a few seconds when the picked items have nothing in common to build locators from.

multipick_dialog.description: Multi-pick: aria-label of the results panel, read by screen readers.

multipick_title_one.description: Multi-pick: title of the results panel. $base$ is the locator every result starts from, as code (kept as it is).

multipick_title_other.description: Multi-pick: title of the results panel. $base$ is the locator every result starts from, as code (kept as it is).

multipick_count_one.message: The shared locator finds $count$ element on the page right now
multipick_count_one.description: Multi-pick results: line under the title. $count$ is how many elements the shared locator shown in the title finds on the page as it is now.

multipick_count_other.message: The shared locator finds $count$ elements on the page right now
multipick_count_other.description: Multi-pick results: line under the title. $count$ is how many elements the shared locator shown in the title finds on the page as it is now.

multipick_byPosition.message: Found by its position (nth): it breaks if the order of the list changes
multipick_byPosition.description: Multi-pick: warning under a locator that finds its item only by its place in the list. “nth” is Playwright code, kept as it is.

lint_dialog.message: Lint overlay: elements hard to target
lint_dialog.description: Lint overlay: aria-label of its panel, read by screen readers. Starts with the tool’s name as the popup shows it.

lint_none.description: Lint overlay: panel title when every button, link and field of the page can be targeted by a good locator.

lint_found_one.description: Lint overlay: panel title. $count$ is how many buttons, links or fields have no test id, no name and no stable place, so no good locator finds them.

lint_found_other.description: Lint overlay: panel title. $count$ is how many buttons, links or fields have no test id, no name and no stable place, so no good locator finds them.

lint_close.description: Lint overlay: aria-label of its × button.

lint_allGood.message: Every button, link and field here has a test id, a name, or a stable place in the page.
lint_allGood.description: Lint overlay: shown under the title when nothing was found.

lint_checking.message: Looking for elements hard to target…
lint_checking.description: Lint overlay: panel title while the page is checked, before the findings are shown.

lint_truncated.message: Checked the first $checked$ of the $total$ buttons, links and fields on this page.
lint_truncated.description: Lint overlay: under the title when the page has more buttons, links and fields than the overlay checks. $checked$ is how many it checked, $total$ how many the page has; both are numbers.

lint_copyChecklist.description: Lint overlay: button that copies every finding as a Markdown checklist, to paste into a ticket. The checklist itself stays in English.

lint_role.description: Lint overlay: after an element’s tag, its ARIA role. $role$ is the role’s name as code, kept as it is.

lint_roleNamed.description: Lint overlay: after an element’s tag, its ARIA role and its accessible name. $role$ is code; $name$ is the page’s own text.

lint_onContainer.description: Lint overlay: above a suggested test id that goes on the element’s container (a row, a card, a list item repeated on the page) rather than on the element. $tag$ is the container’s HTML tag as code, kept as it is; $text$ is the page’s own text that tells this container apart from its copies.

lint_scopeBy.message: Scope by the repeated $tag$ holding "$text$": its copies share a test id already
lint_scopeBy.description: Lint overlay: above a locator to use instead of adding a test id, when the element sits in a repeated container (row, card, list item) whose copies all carry the same test id. $tag$ is the container’s HTML tag as code, kept as it is; $text$ is the page’s own text that tells this container apart.

lint_thenLocator.message: A test then finds it with
lint_thenLocator.description: Lint overlay: before the locator a test uses once the suggested test id is added to the element’s container.

assert_dialog.description: Assertions panel: accessible name of the dialog that lists expect(…) lines for a picked element.

assert_count_one.description: Assertions panel title: how many expect(…) lines it suggests for the picked element.

assert_count_other.description: Assertions panel title: how many expect(…) lines it suggests for the picked element.

assert_none.description: Assertions panel title when it has nothing to suggest for the picked element.

assert_locator.description: Assertions panel, under the title. $locator$ is the Playwright locator every suggested line uses, shown as code (e.g. getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay' })).

assert_noLocator.message: No locator found for this element, so there is no assertion to suggest.
assert_noLocator.description: Assertions panel, in place of the list, when no locator could be built for the picked element.

agent_title.description: Agent context panel: its title and the dialog’s accessible name. The panel shows a text block describing the picked element, to paste into an AI coding assistant.

agent_hint.message: Paste this into your AI coding assistant
agent_hint.description: Agent context panel, under the title, before “Esc to close”. The block below it stays in English: it is written for the AI.

session_remove.description: Session panel: accessible name of the × button of one element of the list. $name$ is the name the user gave it (a code identifier).

session_copyPageObject.description: Session panel button: copies the list as a TypeScript page object class.

session_copyMarkdown.description: Session panel button: copies the list as a Markdown table.

session_copyJson.description: Session panel button: copies the list as JSON.

session_clear.description: Session panel button: removes every named element.

session_nameLabel.description: Piwi sidebar in DevTools, Add to session: accessible name of the text field where the user names the element just chosen.

session_namePlaceholder.description: Piwi sidebar in DevTools, Add to session: placeholder of the name field. “submitButton” is an example of a code name: keep it as it is.

session_nameRequired.description: Piwi sidebar in DevTools, Add to session: error under the name field when it is empty.

session_nameInvalid.message: Use only letters without accents, digits, _ or $$, and do not start with a digit.
session_nameInvalid.description: Piwi sidebar in DevTools, Add to session: error under the name field when the name cannot be a code name. $$ writes a dollar sign.

session_nameReserved.message: The page object already uses the name $name$: choose another one.
session_nameReserved.description: Piwi sidebar in DevTools, Add to session: error under the name field when the exported page object uses that name itself (page, constructor). $name$ is the name typed, kept as code.

session_nameTaken.description: Piwi sidebar in DevTools, Add to session: error under the name field when another element of the list has that name. $name$ is the name typed.

pick_overlayBanner.message: Piwi inspector — click any element to generate locators for it
pick_overlayBanner.description: Picking overlay: the banner at the top of the page while an element is picked (Pick an element, Multi-pick, Assertions, Context for an AI agent).

pick_overlayKeys.message: Enter picks the focused element · ↑ parent · ↓ child · Esc skip
pick_overlayKeys.description: Picking overlay: the line under the banner before the pointer is on an element. Enter picks the element that has the keyboard focus; ↑ and ↓ are the arrow keys, which move the pick to the element’s parent or child; Esc skips the pick. Short.

pick_overlayKeysHovering.message: click or Enter to pick · ↑ parent · ↓ child · Esc skip
pick_overlayKeysHovering.description: Picking overlay: the line under the banner while the pointer is on an element: a click or Enter picks that element, then the keys of pick_overlayKeys. Short.

pick_overlayAnalyzing.description: Picking overlay: the line under the banner once an element is picked, while its locators are worked out.

pick_anchorsTitle.description: Pick an element, anchors step: title of the panel listing the picked element’s parents, any of which the locator may start from.

pick_anchorsHint.message: Pick one or more parents to anchor the locator to. Hover a row to see the parent.
pick_anchorsHint.description: Pick an element, anchors step: the hint under the title.

pick_anchorsNoneSelected.message: No parents selected — standard alternatives only.
pick_anchorsNoneSelected.description: Pick an element, anchors step: the line under the list when no parent is selected: the results will list the usual locators only.

pick_anchorsMatchesOne.description: Pick an element, anchors step: the line under the list when the selected parents and the element find one element on the page.

pick_anchorsMatchesMany.description: Pick an element, anchors step: as pick_anchorsMatchesOne, when they find several or none. $count$ is any number but 1, 0 included.

pick_anchorsCountUnavailable.description: Pick an element, anchors step: the line under the list when the number of elements found cannot be counted.

pick_anchorsContainsOne.description: Pick an element, anchors step: under a parent, how many elements like the picked one it contains. Lower case: it follows the parent’s code.

pick_anchorsContainsMany.description: Pick an element, anchors step: as pick_anchorsContainsOne. $count$ is any number but 1, or ? when it cannot be counted.

pick_anchorsNeedsTestId.message: add a data-testid to make this usable
pick_anchorsNeedsTestId.description: Pick an element, anchors step: under a parent the locator cannot start from, which has no test id, id or named role. data-testid is code, kept as it is. Lower case.

pick_anchorsNoHook.description: Pick an element, anchors step: next to a parent’s tag, in place of its test id, id or role, when it has none.

pick_anchorsUse.description: Pick an element, anchors step: button that builds the locators from the selected parents.

pick_anchorsSkip.description: Pick an element, anchors step: button that goes to the results without a parent; Esc does the same. Short.

pick_panelLabel.description: Pick results: aria-label of the panel that lists the locators found for the element the user picked.

pick_title_one.description: Pick results: the panel’s title. $count$ is how many locators were found for the picked element; they are listed from the most stable down.

pick_title_other.description: Pick results: the panel’s title. $count$ is how many locators were found for the picked element; they are listed from the most stable down.

pick_tabHint.description: Pick results: hint under the title, after “Esc to close ·”: the Tab key moves the focus from one locator to the next. Short.

pick_copyAll_one.description: Pick results: button in the header that copies every locator of the list. $count$ is how many. Short: it sits next to the close button.

pick_copyAll_other.description: Pick results: button in the header that copies every locator of the list. $count$ is how many. Short: it sits next to the close button.

pick_copyAllHint.message: Copy every locator, one per line, to paste into Piwi’s Locators page and find the tests that use them
pick_copyAllHint.description: Pick results: tooltip of the “Copy all” button. “Locators” is the name of a page of the Piwi dashboard.

pick_score.message: Stability score: the higher, the less likely the locator breaks when the page changes
pick_score.description: Pick results: tooltip of the number shown before each locator.

pick_unique.message: Finds exactly one element on the page right now
pick_unique.description: Pick results: under a locator, after a ✓, when the locator finds only the picked element on the page as it is now.

pick_ambiguous_one.message: Finds $count$ element right now: add $first$ or $filter$ to keep one
pick_ambiguous_one.description: Pick results: under a locator, after a ⚠, when the locator finds several elements on the page. $count$ is how many. $first$ and $filter$ are Playwright code the user can add to the locator: .first() and .filter({ hasText: … }).

pick_ambiguous_other.message: Finds $count$ elements right now: add $first$ or $filter$ to keep one
pick_ambiguous_other.description: Pick results: under a locator, after a ⚠, when the locator finds several elements on the page. $count$ is how many. $first$ and $filter$ are Playwright code the user can add to the locator: .first() and .filter({ hasText: … }).

pick_narrowed_one.message: Finds exactly this element: the locator it narrows finds $count$ element
pick_narrowed_one.description: Pick results: under a locator, after a ✓, when it was built from another locator of the list that finds several elements (made exact, filtered by text, or scoped to a parent), and finds only the picked element. $count$ is how many elements the other locator finds, 2 or more.

pick_narrowed_other.message: Finds exactly this element: the locator it narrows finds $count$ elements
pick_narrowed_other.description: Pick results: under a locator, after a ✓, when it was built from another locator of the list that finds several elements (made exact, filtered by text, or scoped to a parent), and finds only the picked element. $count$ is how many elements the other locator finds, 2 or more.

pick_byPosition_one.message: Finds this element by its position among $count$: breaks when their order changes
pick_byPosition_one.description: Pick results: under a locator ending in .first() or .nth(…), after a ⚠, offered when no other locator finds the picked element alone. $count$ is how many elements the locator without .first()/.nth() finds.

pick_byPosition_other.message: Finds this element by its position among $count$: breaks when their order changes
pick_byPosition_other.description: Pick results: under a locator ending in .first() or .nth(…), after a ⚠, offered when no other locator finds the picked element alone. $count$ is how many elements the locator without .first()/.nth() finds.

pick_topPick.message: Best choice: the most stable locator.
pick_topPick.description: Pick results: note under the first locator of the list.

pick_whereBranch.description: Pick results: a project and the branch its tests are read from, inserted as $where$ in the Piwi section’s sentences (“Tests of $where$”). $project$ is the project’s name, $branch$ a git branch name.

pick_whereAnyBranch.description: Pick results: a project whose tests are read from every branch, inserted as $where$ in the Piwi section’s sentences. $project$ is the project’s name.

pick_checking.message: Looking for the tests of $where$ that reach this element…
pick_checking.description: Pick results: shown while the extension looks for the project’s tests whose locators find the picked element. $where$ is the project’s name, maybe with its branch (see pick_whereBranch).

pick_indexNotReady.message: The tested elements of this project are not available yet.
pick_indexNotReady.description: Pick results: Piwi has not built the list of what the project’s tests reach yet.

pick_indexFailed.message: The tested elements could not be loaded: $error$
pick_indexFailed.description: Pick results: loading what the project’s tests reach failed. $error$ is the reason, a sentence.

error.example: The instance rejected the API key for this project.

pick_testsOf.description: Pick results: heading of the Piwi section when its tests could not be read. $where$ is the project’s name, maybe with its branch.

pick_findInPiwi.description: Pick results: link that opens the Piwi dashboard’s Locators page with the listed locators. The ↗ says it opens a new tab.

pick_showInside.description: Pick results: button that opens Tested elements limited to the picked element and what it contains.

pick_showInsideHint.message: Open Tested elements for this element only
pick_showInsideHint.description: Pick results: tooltip of the “Show tested elements inside it” button. “Tested elements” is the name of a tool.

pick_showAll.description: Pick results: button that opens Tested elements on the whole page.

pick_showAllHint.message: Open Tested elements on this page
pick_showAllHint.description: Pick results: tooltip of the “Show every tested element” button. “Tested elements” is the name of a tool.

pick_groupSelf.description: Pick results: heading above the tests whose locators find the picked element itself.

pick_groupInside_one.description: Pick results: heading above the tests whose locators find something inside the picked element. $count$ is how many elements inside it they find.

pick_groupInside_other.description: Pick results: heading above the tests whose locators find something inside the picked element. $count$ is how many elements inside it they find.

pick_groupAroundOne.description: Pick results: heading above the tests whose locators find one element around the picked one. $element$ describes that element, as a CSS-like tag and its text, taken from the page.

pick_groupAround_one.description: Pick results: heading above the tests whose locators find elements around the picked one. $count$ is how many such elements.

pick_groupAround_other.description: Pick results: heading above the tests whose locators find elements around the picked one. $count$ is how many such elements.

pick_reachedBy_one.description: Pick results: heading of the Piwi section. $count$ tests of the project have a locator that finds the picked element (or something inside it). $where$ is the project’s name, maybe with its branch.

pick_reachedBy_other.description: Pick results: heading of the Piwi section. $count$ tests of the project have a locator that finds the picked element (or something inside it). $where$ is the project’s name, maybe with its branch.

pick_notReached.message: Not reached by any test of $where$
pick_notReached.description: Pick results: heading of the Piwi section when no test of the project has a locator that finds the picked element. $where$ is the project’s name, maybe with its branch.

pick_onlyAround.message: No test finds this element or anything inside it. These tests reach an element around it.
pick_onlyAround.description: Pick results: under “Not reached by any test”, when some tests reach an element that contains the picked one.

pick_noneHere.message: No locator in the project’s tests finds this element on this page.
pick_noneHere.description: Pick results: under “Not reached by any test”, when no test reaches the element nor anything around it.

pick_more_one.message: $count$ more: Tested elements lists them all.
pick_more_one.description: Pick results: after the first few tests listed, how many are not shown. “Tested elements” is the name of a tool.

pick_more_other.message: $count$ more: Tested elements lists them all.
pick_more_other.description: Pick results: after the first few tests listed, how many are not shown. “Tested elements” is the name of a tool.

pick_brittle.description: Pick results: a locator of the project’s tests that finds the picked element but may break easily. $locator$ is the locator, as code; $reasons$ lists why it is brittle (“CSS class · CSS structure”).

pick_useRankedInstead.message: These tests could use one of the locators listed above instead.
pick_useRankedInstead.description: Pick results: after the brittle locators of the project’s tests.

pick_sendToEditor.description: Button on a picked locator: inserts it, in the chosen copy form, at the cursor of the editor paired with Piwi Picker (VS Code or a JetBrains IDE).

functions_title.description: Test functions: the panel’s title and aria-label. The panel checks each test function of the project against the page open.

functions_manage.message: Manage the functions of $project$ in Piwi ↗
functions_manage.description: Test functions: link under the title to the project’s function catalog in the Piwi dashboard. $project$ is the project’s name. The ↗ says it opens a new tab.

functions_refreshHint.message: Download this project’s functions from Piwi again
functions_refreshHint.description: Test functions: tooltip of the Refresh button.

functions_noProject.message: No Piwi project is mapped to this site yet. Open Piwi Picker’s settings and add the site under Project mappings, or choose a project under Active project in Piwi Picker’s menu.
functions_noProject.description: Test functions: shown instead of the list when no project applies to the page. “Project mappings” is a section of the settings page (options_mappingsHeading), “Active project” the popup’s select (popup_activeProject).

functions_empty.message: $project$ has no test functions yet. Add one in the Piwi dashboard, by hand or by pasting a function’s code.
functions_empty.description: Test functions: shown instead of the list when the project’s catalog is empty. $project$ is the project’s name.

functions_refreshFailed.message: $error$ The functions shown are the last ones downloaded.
functions_refreshFailed.description: Test functions: shown above the list when the Refresh button failed. $error$ is the reason, a sentence ending with a period.

error.example: The function catalog could not be refreshed.

functions_cacheFailed.message: The test functions kept in this browser could not be read. Refresh to download them again.
functions_cacheFailed.description: Test functions: shown instead of the list when the functions downloaded before cannot be read from the browser’s storage. “Refresh” is the button in the panel’s header (common_refresh).

functions_ready.description: Test functions: badge next to a function when every one of its steps finds exactly one element on the page. Short. In French it agrees with “fonction” (feminine).

functions_partial.description: Test functions: badge next to a function when some of its steps find their element on the page and others do not, or find several. Short. In French it agrees with “fonction” (feminine).

functions_notFound.description: Test functions: badge next to a function when none of its steps finds an element on the page. Short. In French it agrees with “fonction” (feminine).

functions_stepUnique.description: Test functions: a step of a function, whose target is exactly one element of the page. $action$ is the Playwright action, as code (click, fill…).

functions_stepAmbiguous_one.description: Test functions: a step of a function whose target matches several elements of the page. $action$ is the Playwright action, as code; $count$ how many elements.

functions_stepAmbiguous_other.description: Test functions: a step of a function whose target matches several elements of the page. $action$ is the Playwright action, as code; $count$ how many elements.

functions_stepMissing.description: Test functions: a step of a function whose target is not on the page. $action$ is the Playwright action, as code.

record_hudTitle_one.description: Recorder HUD, top line while a recording runs, next to a red dot and the Stop button: how many steps are recorded so far. Short: the HUD is narrow.

record_hudTitle_other.description: Recorder HUD, top line while a recording runs, next to a red dot and the Stop button: how many steps are recorded so far. Short: the HUD is narrow.

record_hudTitleInto_one.description: Recorder HUD in a browser the editor (VS Code, a JetBrains IDE) opened for a recording, top line next to a red dot and the Stop button: the file the steps are written into, and how many steps are recorded so far. $file$ is the file name. Short: the HUD is narrow.

record_hudTitleInto_other.description: Recorder HUD in a browser the editor (VS Code, a JetBrains IDE) opened for a recording, top line next to a red dot and the Stop button: the file the steps are written into, and how many steps are recorded so far. $file$ is the file name. Short: the HUD is narrow.

record_hudLabel.description: Recorder bar shown on the page while a recording runs: its accessible name, read by screen readers, not shown.

record_pause.description: Recorder bar, while a recording runs: button that pauses the recording, so nothing done in the page is recorded until Resume. Short.

record_resume.description: Recorder bar, while a recording is paused: button that resumes it. Short.

record_pausedNote.message: Paused: what you do here is not recorded until you resume.
record_pausedNote.description: Recorder bar, while the recording is paused: one line under the title.

record_checkElement.description: Recorder bar: button that lets the person pick an element and add a check (an assertion) of what it shows now, such as its text. Also the title of the dialog it opens. Short: the bar is narrow.

record_checkAddress.description: Recorder bar: button that adds a check (an assertion) of the page's address. Also the title of the dialog it opens. Short.

record_checkOn.description: “Check an element” dialog: under the title, the locator of the chosen element. $locator$ is Playwright code, never translated.

record_checkWhat.description: “Check an element” dialog: label of the list of what can be checked about the element.

record_checkText.description: “Check an element” dialog: a choice in “What to check”: the text the element shows.

record_checkValue.description: “Check an element” dialog: a choice in “What to check”: the value of a field.
